up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for compounds tested against the human target 'C-C chemokine receptor type 2'. For each result, return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, target_pref_name, and organism. Constraints: 1) The activity type must be IC50 and units must be nM. 2) The target organism must be 'Homo sapiens'. 3) Only include rows where the compound has a valid SMILES (canonical_smiles is not null) AND a valid PubMed ID or DOI exists. 4) The target name should match 'C-C chemokine receptor type 2' (or similar pref_name).
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism AS organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND td.pref_name = 'C-C chemokine receptor type 2' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) IS NOT NULL
